sequences.title: The Vesper Bell
sequences.notes: Two cards over the title; the second ends on the player's goal, the road into town (AC-5: what am I trying to do next).

pages.text: For as long as anyone in the valley can say, a bell was rung at dusk in the hills above Briar Glen. Sixty-one years ago it stopped. The children still skip to a rhyme about an ox that stays awake beneath the hill. Nobody remembers who for.

Three weeks ago the sleepers began to walk. Six have gone out of their beds at night and into the dark, and a bounty is about to go up on the Market Green. You are on the mountain road, and it is nearly dusk.
